limitations: No input overlay: cannot prove absence of Reload or a second trigger input.
Historical 2022 recording; weapon roll, reload modifiers and Rapid Hit state are not controlled.
Uploader frame-count claims were not adopted. No base nock duration, input-to-reload delay, perfect-draw window, overdraw threshold or damage scalar is measured.
Observed return to a loaded idle bow supports the nock/draw distinction; automatic initiation remains a direction inference.

sources.supports: Global accessibility Full Auto toggle is distinct from native weapon fire mode. No all-weapons post-reload guarantee.
Held-trigger Full Auto stoppage was a bug; a separate fix prevents charge-based weapons skipping charge delay after empty-mag auto loading.
Designer Greg Peng says early release changes arrow trajectory. Does not specify current damage or velocity interpolation.
sources.videoStatus: Embedded Brightcove video returned 404; not claimed viewed.

sources.supports: Gameplay section describes early/undrawn releases, reduced damage/speed and greater arc, reload letdown, and eventual forced release. Not a primary quantitative specification.
Expected empty-mag reload while maintaining fire/ADS; actual bug. Inputs are author-reported, not observed telemetry.
Full Auto expected when fire is held through reload; actual controller jamming. Does not establish default semi-auto behavior.
BNGHelp8 acknowledges investigation of this exotic/settings issue; not a universal reload or resume rule.
Author contrasts held-fire empty reload on sniper/SMG with LFR requiring manual reload or release/repress after a patch. Historical anomaly, not universal charged-weapon policy.
Reports sprint-cancelled reload animation still leaves a firing delay; exact cancellation/commit/restart rules unverified.

authoredDirection.emptyReload: Queue after last successful shot and burst drain, independent of needing another press; initial scheduling bounded by next server tick.
authoredDirection.automaticResume: Only supported intrinsic automatic profiles with maintained real fire input, after reload and existing firing gates.
authoredDirection.semiAuto: No extra queued shot from old press.
authoredDirection.chargedWeapons: Fusion/LFR require fresh press under this project scope; not claimed universal Destiny behavior.
authoredDirection.bow: Successful released shot schedules nock; nock completion loads an arrow, never fires one. Draw time begins only after nock. Q cancels draw without a projectile.
authoredDirection.partialDraw: Positive early-release shot uses explicitly authored interpolation; no source-backed exact Destiny scalar.
authoredDirection.timings: Unknown. Next-tick initiation and any interpolation are implementation decisions, not measured Destiny constants.
